properties.text: Ukrainian forces advanced in the Oleksandrivka direction.

[29] A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced into northwestern Nova Sich (north of Sumy City) and south of Yunakivka (northeast of Sumy City).[30] Ukrainian forces continued their short- and mid-range strike campaign against Russian military assets in Bryansk Oblast.

The Ukrainian General Staff reported that Ukrainian forces struck a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control point in Dvorichna (northeast of Kupyansk).[38] Ukrainian officials and open-source reporting refute Russian claims that Russian forces seized Borova.

Mashovets reported that Russian forces are attempting to push Ukrainian forces north from Uspenivka (south of Oleksandrivka) on the western bank of the Yanchur River at the junction of the Russian 5th and 36th CAAs (both EMD) and that Russian forces are attempting to advance toward Nove Zaporizhzhia (southwest of Oleksandrivka) to cut off the Ukrainian GLOC to Dobropillya (north of Hulyaipole).

The Ukrainian General Staff reported on May 18 that Ukrainian forces struck a Russian drone control point near Kamyanske (roughly three kilometers from the frontline southwest of Orikhiv) on the night of May 17 to 18.[59] Russian forces continued limited ground attacks in the Kherson direction on May 18 but did not advance.

Gerasimov also claimed that Russian forces entered Velyka Shapkivka (northwest of Kupyansk), seized all of Borova (south of Kupyansk) and Kutkivka (north of Kupyansk); and seized about 50 percent of Shyikivka (southeast of Borova) and 85 percent of Lyman.

The Ukrainian General Staff reported on May 16 that Ukrainian forces struck a Russian personnel concentration near Yalta (south of Novopavlivka and roughly five kilometers from the frontline) on May 15 or overnight on May 15 to 16.[35] Russian forces continued limited ground assaults in the Oleksandrivka direction on May 16 but did not advance, as Ukrainian forces reportedly counterattacked in the area.
